name: rust-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of Rust, kept locally: the book, the language reference and the standard library (core, alloc, std). Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look an API up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of Rust: The Rust Programming Language (the book), The Rust Reference and the standard library (core, alloc, std). Returns 10 section ids at most.
